messages.content: Marty has 100 centimeters of ribbon that he must cut into 4 equal parts. Each of the cut parts must be divided into 5 equal parts. How long will each final cut be?

content.text:
# Solving Marty's Ribbon Problem

**Step 1: Cut the 100 cm ribbon into 4 equal parts.**
$$100 \div 4 = 25 \text{ cm per part}$$

**Step 2: Divide each 25 cm part into 5 equal parts.**
$$25 \div 5 = 5 \text{ cm per final piece}$$

**Each final cut will be 5 centimeters long.**
